plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.A. in History, McCausland College of Arts and Sciences, Dept. of History, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_hist_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (15/15/15/15/15/15/15/13 at slot minimums = 118 total; official degree minimum 120 per Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 27 major, 49-61 college/program, 32-44 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA — range slots/electives fill to 120+). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Carolina Core ARP (3-4) at 3; Foreign language/other CC (3-4) at 3; Carolina Core Req (3-4) at 3; 'Elective only if needed' (1-3) at 1. History major: HIST 300 + 1 US 300+ + 1 European 300+ + 1 World 300+ + pre-modern/modern breadth + senior seminar/thesis (HIST 497/498/499) + 4 history electives 200+; 12-hr advanced cognate or 18+ hr minor; foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 122 course; one U.S. + one non-U.S. History required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
